Delivery Policy

At TOOSA, we're all about doing what we can to deliver your new workspace essentials right to your door!

Local Delivery: We offer local delivery in the Lower Mainland, including Vancouver, Richmond, and the Tri-Cities area, for a flat rate of $100. We want to make sure your new workbench or cabinet arrives safely and swiftly.

Outside of Local Areas: If you're outside Vancouver and nearby cities, no worries! Just reach out to us for a custom delivery quote.

Got any questions about delivery? Feel free to contact us—we're always happy to assist!

Return & Exchange Policy

At TOOSA, we're committed to providing you with high-quality, durable products that you'll love.

Because of this, we do not offer returns or exchanges after purchase. We believe in the quality of our workbenches, cabinets, and workstands, and we're confident they will meet your needs.

We provide free in-person & virtual product demos at your service to ensure that you're choosing the perfect TOOSA product for your workspace before making a purchase.

Thank you for understanding and for choosing TOOSA!

settings.accordion_1_content:
We offer multiple shipping options to suit your needs:

  • Standard Shipping: 3-5 business days
  • Express Shipping: 1-2 business days
  • International Shipping: 7-14 business days

Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location and order weight.
settings.accordion_2_content:
Items must meet the following conditions to be eligible for return:

  • Returned within 30 days of delivery
  • In original, unused condition with tags attached
  • In original packaging
  • Accompanied by proof of purchase

Some items like final sale products, personalized items, and intimate apparel cannot be returned.
settings.accordion_3_content:
Starting a return is simple:

  • Log into your account and go to Order History
  • Select the order and items you wish to return
  • Choose your reason for return
  • Print your prepaid return label
  • Pack items securely and attach the label
  • Drop off at any authorized shipping location

You'll receive email confirmation once we receive and process your return.
settings.accordion_4_content:
We want you to love your purchase! Here are your options:

  • Exchange for a different size or color at no additional cost
  • Receive store credit for the full purchase amount
  • Get a refund to your original payment method

Store credit never expires and can be used on any future purchase. Exchanges are subject to product availability.
